<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="audiosig-api-reference">
<h1>AudioSig API Reference</h1>
<section id="core-functions">
<h2>Core Functions</h2>
<section id="waveform-construction-and-channels">
<h3>Waveform Construction and Channels</h3>
<section id="generate-silence-duration-sample-rate-dtype-np-float32">
<h4><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">generate_silence(duration,</span> <span class="pre">sample_rate,</span> <span class="pre">*,</span> <span class="pre">dtype=np.float32)</span></code></h4>
<p>Return a newly allocated one-dimensional mono NumPy buffer filled with zeros.
Duration is in seconds, sample rate is in samples per second, and the sample
count is exactly <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">int(duration</span> <span class="pre">*</span> <span class="pre">sample_rate)</span></code>, so fractional sample counts
are truncated. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">dtype</span></code> must be a real NumPy floating dtype; the default is
float32. Invalid duration, sample rate, and dtype values raise
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">InvalidParameterError</span></code>. Long silence creation should use bounded
application-level chunks rather than one arbitrarily large array.</p>
</section>
<section id="downmix-to-mono-audio-channel-axis-1">
<h4><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">downmix_to_mono(audio,</span> <span class="pre">*,</span> <span class="pre">channel_axis=-1)</span></code></h4>
<p>Return a caller-owned mono array by taking the arithmetic mean over the
explicit channel axis. Input must be a finite real floating one- or
two-dimensional NumPy array; the source dtype and frame order are preserved.
One-dimensional input is already mono and is copied. The operation does not
clip or normalize amplitude. Invalid shape, axis, dtype, or sample values
raise <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">AudioShapeError</span></code>; the result is contiguous.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">downmix_to_mono</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">generate_silence</span>

<span class="n">silence</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">generate_silence</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mf">0.5</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">24_000</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">mono_soundfile</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">downmix_to_mono</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">frames_first</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">channel_axis</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">mono_audiosig</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">downmix_to_mono</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">channels_first</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">channel_axis</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>These functions do not perform file decoding/encoding, URL handling, playback,
streaming, or audiobook composition.</p>
</section>
</section>
<section id="time-and-pitch-effects">
<h3>Time and Pitch Effects</h3>
<section id="time-stretch-audio-rate-sample-rate-none-method-phase-vocoder-axis-1-n-fft-2048-hop-length-none">
<h4><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">time_stretch(audio,</span> <span class="pre">rate,</span> <span class="pre">*,</span> <span class="pre">sample_rate=None,</span> <span class="pre">method='phase_vocoder',</span> <span class="pre">axis=-1,</span> <span class="pre">n_fft=2048,</span> <span class="pre">hop_length=None)</span></code></h4>
<p>Change audio duration while approximately preserving pitch.</p>
<p><strong>Parameters:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">audio</span></code> (np.ndarray): Input audio array</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">rate</span></code> (float): Stretch factor. Values &gt; 1.0 make audio faster/shorter, &lt; 1.0 slower/longer</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sample_rate</span></code> (int, optional): Required when <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">method='wsola'</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">method='esola'</span></code>; used for speech-time geometry</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">method</span></code> (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'phase_vocoder'</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'wsola'</span></code>, or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'esola'</span></code>): Select the generic or speech-oriented backend. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'td_psola'</span></code> is intentionally not a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">time_stretch</span></code> method.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">axis</span></code> (int): Sample axis (default: -1)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">n_fft</span></code> (int): FFT window size (default: 2048)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">hop_length</span></code> (int, optional): Hop size. Defaults to n_fft // 4</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Returns:</strong> np.ndarray - Stretched audio with same dtype as input</p>
<p><strong>Raises:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">InvalidParameterError</span></code>: If rate is not positive or parameters are invalid</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">AudioShapeError</span></code>: If audio array is invalid</p></li>
</ul>
<p>ESOLA is an experimental speech backend with exact output length
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">round(input_samples</span> <span class="pre">/</span> <span class="pre">rate)</span></code> and supported rates from 0.5 through 2.0. It
does not make a general music-quality or formant-preservation claim.</p>
<p><strong>Example:</strong></p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">numpy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">np</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">time_stretch</span>

<span class="n">audio</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">random</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">randn</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">24000</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">astype</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">float32</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">faster</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">time_stretch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">1.2</span><span class="p">)</span>  <span class="c1"># 20% faster</span>
<span class="n">slower</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">time_stretch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.8</span><span class="p">)</span>  <span class="c1"># 20% slower</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<hr class="docutils" />
<section id="pitch-shift-audio-sample-rate-semitones-bins-per-octave-12-method-phase-vocoder-axis-1-n-fft-2048-hop-length-none-filter-width-32-rolloff-0-945">
<h4><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pitch_shift(audio,</span> <span class="pre">*,</span> <span class="pre">sample_rate,</span> <span class="pre">semitones,</span> <span class="pre">bins_per_octave=12,</span> <span class="pre">method='phase_vocoder',</span> <span class="pre">axis=-1,</span> <span class="pre">n_fft=2048,</span> <span class="pre">hop_length=None,</span> <span class="pre">filter_width=32,</span> <span class="pre">rolloff=0.945)</span></code></h4>
<p>Shift pitch by semitones while preserving exact input duration.</p>
<p><strong>Parameters:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">audio</span></code> (np.ndarray): Input audio array</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sample_rate</span></code> (int): Audio sample rate in Hz</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">semitones</span></code> (float): Pitch shift in semitones (positive = higher, negative = lower)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">bins_per_octave</span></code> (int): Semitones per octave (default: 12)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">axis</span></code> (int): Sample axis (default: -1)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">n_fft</span></code> (int): FFT window size (default: 2048)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">hop_length</span></code> (int, optional): Hop size</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">filter_width</span></code> (int): Resampling filter width (default: 32)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">method</span></code> (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'phase_vocoder'</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'wsola'</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'esola'</span></code>, or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'td_psola'</span></code>): Pitch method. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">td_psola</span></code> directly synthesizes voiced speech and does not resample the complete waveform.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">rolloff</span></code> (float): Pitch-resampler rolloff (default: 0.945)</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Returns:</strong> np.ndarray - Pitch-shifted audio with exact same length as input</p>
<p><strong>Example:</strong></p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">pitch_shift</span>

<span class="c1"># Raise pitch by 2 semitones</span>
<span class="n">higher</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">pitch_shift</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sample_rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">24000</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">semitones</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">2.0</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Lower pitch by 5 semitones</span>
<span class="n">lower</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">pitch_shift</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sample_rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">24000</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">semitones</span><span class="o">=-</span><span class="mf">5.0</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="apply-speech-effects-audio-sample-rate-rate-1-0-semitones-0-0-gain-db-0-0-axis-1-clip-false-method-wsola-n-fft-2048-hop-length-none-filter-width-32-rolloff-0-945">
<h4><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">apply_speech_effects(audio,</span> <span class="pre">*,</span> <span class="pre">sample_rate,</span> <span class="pre">rate=1.0,</span> <span class="pre">semitones=0.0,</span> <span class="pre">gain_db=0.0,</span> <span class="pre">axis=-1,</span> <span class="pre">clip=False,</span> <span class="pre">method='wsola',</span> <span class="pre">n_fft=2048,</span> <span class="pre">hop_length=None,</span> <span class="pre">filter_width=32,</span> <span class="pre">rolloff=0.945)</span></code></h4>
<p>Apply numeric speech effects using one planned pitch/rate time-scale pass,
optional resampling, and gain. WSOLA is the default speech backend;
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">method='phase_vocoder'</span></code> selects the generic reference path,
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">method='esola'</span></code> selects the experimental epoch-synchronous path, and
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">method='td_psola'</span></code> selects the experimental direct speech pitch/prosody path.
The output length is exactly <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">round(input_samples</span> <span class="pre">/</span> <span class="pre">rate)</span></code> for non-empty input.
TD-PSOLA supports <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">0.75</span> <span class="pre">&lt;=</span> <span class="pre">rate</span> <span class="pre">&lt;=</span> <span class="pre">1.5</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">-6</span> <span class="pre">&lt;=</span> <span class="pre">semitones</span> <span class="pre">&lt;=</span> <span class="pre">6</span></code>; it does not
guarantee vocal-formant preservation. This compositor does not parse SSMD strings and raises typed
AudioSig exceptions for invalid input or parameters.</p>
</section>
</section>
<hr class="docutils" />
<section id="resampling">
<h3>Resampling</h3>
<section id="resample-audio-source-rate-target-rate-axis-1-filter-width-32-rolloff-0-945-length-mode-round">
<h4><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">resample(audio,</span> <span class="pre">*,</span> <span class="pre">source_rate,</span> <span class="pre">target_rate,</span> <span class="pre">axis=-1,</span> <span class="pre">filter_width=32,</span> <span class="pre">rolloff=0.945,</span> <span class="pre">length_mode='round')</span></code></h4>
<p>Resample audio with a windowed-sinc anti-aliasing filter.</p>
<p><strong>Parameters:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">audio</span></code> (np.ndarray): Input audio array</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source_rate</span></code> (float): Source sample rate in Hz</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">target_rate</span></code> (float): Target sample rate in Hz</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">axis</span></code> (int): Sample axis (default: -1)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">filter_width</span></code> (int): Filter kernel width (default: 32)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">rolloff</span></code> (float): Filter rolloff frequency (default: 0.945)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">length_mode</span></code> (str): Length calculation mode (‘round’ or ‘ceil’)</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Returns:</strong> np.ndarray - Resampled audio</p>
<p><strong>Output Length:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">length_mode='round'</span></code>: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">round(input_length</span> <span class="pre">*</span> <span class="pre">target_rate</span> <span class="pre">/</span> <span class="pre">source_rate)</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">length_mode='ceil'</span></code>: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ceil(input_length</span> <span class="pre">*</span> <span class="pre">target_rate</span> <span class="pre">/</span> <span class="pre">source_rate)</span></code></p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Example:</strong></p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">resample</span>

<span class="c1"># Downsample from 48kHz to 16kHz</span>
<span class="n">downsampled</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">resample</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio_48k</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">source_rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">48000</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">target_rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">16000</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Upsample from 8kHz to 24kHz</span>
<span class="n">upsampled</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">resample</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio_8k</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">source_rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">8000</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">target_rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">24000</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="resample-to-length-audio-length-axis-1-filter-width-32-rolloff-0-945">
<h4><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">resample_to_length(audio,</span> <span class="pre">length,</span> <span class="pre">*,</span> <span class="pre">axis=-1,</span> <span class="pre">filter_width=32,</span> <span class="pre">rolloff=0.945)</span></code></h4>
<p>Resample audio to an exact sample count along the selected sample axis. This
is a sample-count operation, not a sample-rate conversion. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">length</span></code> may be
zero; an empty input can only be resampled to zero samples.</p>
</section>
<section id="resample-speed-audio-speed-axis-1-filter-width-32-rolloff-0-945">
<h4><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">resample_speed(audio,</span> <span class="pre">speed,</span> <span class="pre">*,</span> <span class="pre">axis=-1,</span> <span class="pre">filter_width=32,</span> <span class="pre">rolloff=0.945)</span></code></h4>
<p>Change playback speed by resampling. Values above one make audio shorter and
higher pitched; values below one make it longer and lower pitched. Use
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">time_stretch</span></code> when pitch should remain approximately unchanged.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">resample_speed</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">resample_to_length</span>

<span class="n">exact</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">resample_to_length</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio_48k</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">12_000</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">faster</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">resample_speed</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio_48k</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">speed</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">1.25</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<hr class="docutils" />
<section id="amplitude-processing">
<h3>Amplitude Processing</h3>
<section id="apply-gain-db-audio-db-clip-false">
<h4><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">apply_gain_db(audio,</span> <span class="pre">db,</span> <span class="pre">*,</span> <span class="pre">clip=False)</span></code></h4>
<p>Apply a decibel gain to audio.</p>
<p><strong>Parameters:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">audio</span></code> (np.ndarray): Input audio array</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">db</span></code> (float): Gain in decibels (negative = attenuation)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">clip</span></code> (bool): If True, clip output to [-1.0, 1.0] (default: False)</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Returns:</strong> np.ndarray - Gain-adjusted audio</p>
<p><strong>Example:</strong></p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">apply_gain_db</span>

<span class="n">louder</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">apply_gain_db</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">db</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">6.0</span><span class="p">)</span>    <span class="c1"># +6 dB gain</span>
<span class="n">quieter</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">apply_gain_db</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">db</span><span class="o">=-</span><span class="mf">3.0</span><span class="p">)</span>  <span class="c1"># -3 dB attenuation</span>
<span class="n">clipped</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">apply_gain_db</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">db</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">12.0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">clip</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<hr class="docutils" />
<section id="peak-normalize-audio-peak-1-0-eps-1e-12">
<h4><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">peak_normalize(audio,</span> <span class="pre">*,</span> <span class="pre">peak=1.0,</span> <span class="pre">eps=1e-12)</span></code></h4>
<p>Scale audio so its absolute peak equals the target value.</p>
<p><strong>Parameters:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">audio</span></code> (np.ndarray): Input audio array</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">peak</span></code> (float): Target peak amplitude (default: 1.0)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">eps</span></code> (float): Silence threshold (default: 1e-12)</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Returns:</strong> np.ndarray - Normalized audio</p>
<p><strong>Example:</strong></p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">peak_normalize</span>

<span class="c1"># Normalize to 0.9 peak</span>
<span class="n">normalized</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">peak_normalize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">peak</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.9</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Silent audio is returned unchanged</span>
<span class="n">silent</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">zeros</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1000</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">dtype</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">float32</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">still_silent</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">peak_normalize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">silent</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
</section>
<hr class="docutils" />
<section id="silence-detection">
<h2>Silence Detection</h2>
<section id="voice-activity-detection">
<h3>Voice Activity Detection</h3>
<section id="normalized-energy-vad-audio-sample-rate-frame-duration-ms-5-0-energy-threshold-0-02-axis-1-pad-end-false">
<h4><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">normalized_energy_vad(audio,</span> <span class="pre">sample_rate,</span> <span class="pre">*,</span> <span class="pre">frame_duration_ms=5.0,</span> <span class="pre">energy_threshold=0.02,</span> <span class="pre">axis=-1,</span> <span class="pre">pad_end=False)</span></code></h4>
<p>Detect voice activity using normalized RMS energy.</p>
<p><strong>Parameters:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">audio</span></code> (np.ndarray): Input audio array</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sample_rate</span></code> (int): Audio sample rate in Hz</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">frame_duration_ms</span></code> (float): Frame duration in milliseconds (default: 5.0)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">energy_threshold</span></code> (float): Threshold in [0, 1] (default: 0.02)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">axis</span></code> (int): Sample axis (default: -1)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pad_end</span></code> (bool): Include trailing partial frame (default: False)</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Returns:</strong> np.ndarray - Boolean array indicating active frames</p>
<p><strong>Example:</strong></p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">normalized_energy_vad</span>

<span class="n">activity</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">normalized_energy_vad</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">sample_rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">24000</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">frame_duration_ms</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">10</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">energy_threshold</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.15</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Count active frames</span>
<span class="n">active_frames</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">activity</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<hr class="docutils" />
<section id="relative-db-vad-audio-frame-length-2048-hop-length-512-threshold-db-40-0-top-db-none-axis-1-pad-end-false">
<h4><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">relative_db_vad(audio,</span> <span class="pre">*,</span> <span class="pre">frame_length=2048,</span> <span class="pre">hop_length=512,</span> <span class="pre">threshold_db=40.0,</span> <span class="pre">top_db=None,</span> <span class="pre">axis=-1,</span> <span class="pre">pad_end=False)</span></code></h4>
<p>Detect voice activity using relative dB threshold.</p>
<p><strong>Parameters:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">audio</span></code> (np.ndarray): Input audio array</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">frame_length</span></code> (int): Analysis frame length (default: 2048)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">hop_length</span></code> (int): Hop length (default: 512)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">threshold_db</span></code> (float): dB below peak to consider active (default: 40.0)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">top_db</span></code> (float, optional): Alias for threshold_db</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">axis</span></code> (int): Sample axis (default: -1)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pad_end</span></code> (bool): Include trailing partial frame (default: False)</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Returns:</strong> np.ndarray - Boolean array indicating active frames</p>
</section>
<hr class="docutils" />
<section id="energy-based-vad-audio-sample-rate-none-frame-duration-ms-5-0-energy-threshold-none-frame-length-2048-hop-length-512-threshold-db-40-0-top-db-none-axis-1-pad-end-false">
<h4><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">energy_based_vad(audio,</span> <span class="pre">sample_rate=None,</span> <span class="pre">*,</span> <span class="pre">frame_duration_ms=5.0,</span> <span class="pre">energy_threshold=None,</span> <span class="pre">frame_length=2048,</span> <span class="pre">hop_length=512,</span> <span class="pre">threshold_db=40.0,</span> <span class="pre">top_db=None,</span> <span class="pre">axis=-1,</span> <span class="pre">pad_end=False)</span></code></h4>
<p>Unified voice activity detection interface.</p>
<p><strong>Algorithm Selection:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>With <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sample_rate</span></code>: Uses <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">normalized_energy_vad</span></code></p></li>
<li><p>Without <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sample_rate</span></code>: Uses <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">relative_db_vad</span></code></p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Returns:</strong> np.ndarray - Boolean array indicating active frames</p>
</section>
</section>
<hr class="docutils" />
<section id="speech-bounds">
<h3>Speech Bounds</h3>
<section id="find-speech-start-audio-sample-rate-none-kwargs">
<h4><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">find_speech_start(audio,</span> <span class="pre">sample_rate=None,</span> <span class="pre">**kwargs)</span></code></h4>
<p>Find the first active sample index.</p>
<p><strong>Returns:</strong> int - First active sample index, or 0 if no activity</p>
</section>
<hr class="docutils" />
<section id="find-speech-bounds-audio-sample-rate-none-kwargs">
<h4><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">find_speech_bounds(audio,</span> <span class="pre">sample_rate=None,</span> <span class="pre">**kwargs)</span></code></h4>
<p>Find speech start and end bounds.</p>
<p><strong>Returns:</strong> np.ndarray - <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[start,</span> <span class="pre">end]</span></code> sample indices, or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[0,</span> <span class="pre">0]</span></code> if no speech</p>
<p><strong>Example:</strong></p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">find_speech_bounds</span>

<span class="n">bounds</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">find_speech_bounds</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sample_rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">24000</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">array_equal</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">bounds</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]):</span>
    <span class="n">start</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">end</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">bounds</span>
    <span class="n">speech</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">start</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">end</span><span class="p">]</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<hr class="docutils" />
<section id="silence-trimming">
<h3>Silence Trimming</h3>
<section id="trim-audio-top-db-60-0-ref-np-max-frame-length-2048-hop-length-512-aggregate-np-max-axis-1-center-true-pad-mode-constant">
<h4><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">trim(audio,</span> <span class="pre">*,</span> <span class="pre">top_db=60.0,</span> <span class="pre">ref=np.max,</span> <span class="pre">frame_length=2048,</span> <span class="pre">hop_length=512,</span> <span class="pre">aggregate=np.max,</span> <span class="pre">axis=-1,</span> <span class="pre">center=True,</span> <span class="pre">pad_mode='constant')</span></code></h4>
<p>Trim leading and trailing silence.</p>
<p><strong>Parameters:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">audio</span></code> (np.ndarray): Input audio array</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">top_db</span></code> (float): Silence threshold in dB (default: 60.0)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ref</span></code> (float or callable): Reference amplitude (default: np.max)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">frame_length</span></code> (int): Analysis frame length (default: 2048)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">hop_length</span></code> (int): Hop length (default: 512)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">aggregate</span></code> (callable): Aggregation function (default: np.max)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">axis</span></code> (int): Sample axis (default: -1)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">center</span></code> (bool): Use centered frames (default: True)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pad_mode</span></code> (str): Padding mode (default: ‘constant’)</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Returns:</strong> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray] - (trimmed_audio, [start, end])</p>
<p><strong>Example:</strong></p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">trim</span>

<span class="n">trimmed</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">interval</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">trim</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">top_db</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">40.0</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">&quot;Kept samples </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">interval</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> to </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">interval</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<hr class="docutils" />
<section id="split-audio-top-db-60-0-ref-np-max-frame-length-2048-hop-length-512-aggregate-np-max-axis-1-center-true-pad-mode-constant">
<h4><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">split(audio,</span> <span class="pre">*,</span> <span class="pre">top_db=60.0,</span> <span class="pre">ref=np.max,</span> <span class="pre">frame_length=2048,</span> <span class="pre">hop_length=512,</span> <span class="pre">aggregate=np.max,</span> <span class="pre">axis=-1,</span> <span class="pre">center=True,</span> <span class="pre">pad_mode='constant')</span></code></h4>
<p>Split audio into non-silent intervals.</p>
<p><strong>Parameters:</strong> Same as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">trim()</span></code></p>
<p><strong>Returns:</strong> np.ndarray - Array of <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[start,</span> <span class="pre">end)</span></code> half-open intervals, shape <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">(n_intervals,</span> <span class="pre">2)</span></code></p>
<p><strong>Example:</strong></p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">audiosig</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">split</span>

<span class="n">intervals</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">split</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">top_db</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">40.0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">frame_length</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">512</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">hop_length</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">128</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">start</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">end</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">intervals</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">segment</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">start</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">end</span><span class="p">]</span>
    <span class="n">process</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">segment</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
</section>
<hr class="docutils" />
<section id="frame-analysis">
<h2>Frame Analysis</h2>
<section id="frame-signal-audio-frame-length-none-hop-length-none-sample-rate-none-frame-ms-20-0-hop-ms-10-0-axis-1-center-false-pad-mode-constant-pad-end-false">
<h3><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">frame_signal(audio,</span> <span class="pre">*,</span> <span class="pre">frame_length=None,</span> <span class="pre">hop_length=None,</span> <span class="pre">sample_rate=None,</span> <span class="pre">frame_ms=20.0,</span> <span class="pre">hop_ms=10.0,</span> <span class="pre">axis=-1,</span> <span class="pre">center=False,</span> <span class="pre">pad_mode='constant',</span> <span class="pre">pad_end=False)</span></code></h3>
<p>Split audio into overlapping frames.</p>
<p><strong>Parameters:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">audio</span></code> (np.ndarray): Input audio array</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">frame_length</span></code> (int, optional): Frame length in samples</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">hop_length</span></code> (int, optional): Hop length in samples</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sample_rate</span></code> (int, optional): Sample rate (for ms conversion)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">frame_ms</span></code> (float): Frame duration in ms (default: 20.0)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">hop_ms</span></code> (float): Hop duration in ms (default: 10.0)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">axis</span></code> (int): Sample axis (default: -1)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">center</span></code> (bool): Center frames with padding (default: False)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pad_mode</span></code> (str): Padding mode (default: ‘constant’)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pad_end</span></code> (bool): Pad to include trailing samples (default: False)</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Returns:</strong> np.ndarray - Framed audio with shape <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">(...,</span> <span class="pre">n_frames,</span> <span class="pre">frame_length)</span></code></p>
</section>
<hr class="docutils" />
<section id="frame-rms-audio-frame-length-2048-hop-length-512-axis-1-center-true-pad-mode-constant-pad-end-false-normalize-false-dtype-np-float32">
<h3><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">frame_rms(audio,</span> <span class="pre">*,</span> <span class="pre">frame_length=2048,</span> <span class="pre">hop_length=512,</span> <span class="pre">axis=-1,</span> <span class="pre">center=True,</span> <span class="pre">pad_mode='constant',</span> <span class="pre">pad_end=False,</span> <span class="pre">normalize=False,</span> <span class="pre">dtype=np.float32)</span></code></h3>
<p>Compute RMS amplitude for each frame.</p>
<p><strong>Returns:</strong> np.ndarray - RMS values per frame</p>
<p>Set <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pad_end=True</span></code> to include a zero-padded trailing partial frame. Set
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">normalize=True</span></code> to scale each leading-dimension slice independently to
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[0,</span> <span class="pre">1]</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<hr class="docutils" />
<section id="short-time-energy-audio-frame-length-2048-hop-length-512-axis-1-center-false-pad-end-false">
<h3><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">short_time_energy(audio,</span> <span class="pre">*,</span> <span class="pre">frame_length=2048,</span> <span class="pre">hop_length=512,</span> <span class="pre">axis=-1,</span> <span class="pre">center=False,</span> <span class="pre">pad_end=False)</span></code></h3>
<p>Calculate mean-square energy for each frame.</p>
<p><strong>Returns:</strong> np.ndarray - Energy values per frame</p>
</section>
<hr class="docutils" />
<section id="zero-crossing-rate-audio-frame-length-2048-hop-length-512-axis-1-center-false-pad-end-false-normalize-false">
<h3><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">zero_crossing_rate(audio,</span> <span class="pre">*,</span> <span class="pre">frame_length=2048,</span> <span class="pre">hop_length=512,</span> <span class="pre">axis=-1,</span> <span class="pre">center=False,</span> <span class="pre">pad_end=False,</span> <span class="pre">normalize=False)</span></code></h3>
<p>Calculate zero-crossing rate for each frame.</p>
<p><strong>Parameters:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">normalize</span></code> (bool): Normalize to [0, 1] range (default: False)</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Returns:</strong> np.ndarray - Zero-crossing rates per frame</p>
</section>
<hr class="docutils" />
<section id="spectral-flux-audio-frame-length-2048-hop-length-512-axis-1-center-false-pad-end-false-window-hann-normalize-false">
<h3><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">spectral_flux(audio,</span> <span class="pre">*,</span> <span class="pre">frame_length=2048,</span> <span class="pre">hop_length=512,</span> <span class="pre">axis=-1,</span> <span class="pre">center=False,</span> <span class="pre">pad_end=False,</span> <span class="pre">window='hann',</span> <span class="pre">normalize=False)</span></code></h3>
<p>Calculate spectral flux between adjacent frames.</p>
<p><strong>Parameters:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">window</span></code> (str): Window function (‘hann’ or ‘hamming’)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">normalize</span></code> (bool): Normalize to [0, 1] range (default: False)</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Returns:</strong> np.ndarray - Spectral flux values per frame</p>
</section>
</section>

<hr class="docutils" />
<section id="power-to-db-power-ref-1-0-amin-1e-10-top-db-none">

(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
{% endraw %}
